title: 「To the best of my knowledge, …」表示「據我所知」
titleZh: 「To the best of my knowledge, …」表示「據我所知」
titleEn: Using “To the best of my knowledge, ...”

meaning.zh: 此表達表示「根據我目前掌握的全部資料，我相信陳述正確，但不能保證知道所有資料」。它讓說話者提出相信屬實的陳述，同時承認資料可能不完整。

rules.zh: 此短語修飾後面的整項陳述，表示該陳述是根據說話者目前所知而提出。
rules.en: The phrase modifies the whole statement, showing that it is based on the speaker’s current knowledge.

rules.zh: 它不表示完全肯定；說話者相信陳述正確，但承認未必掌握所有資料。
rules.en: It does not express complete certainty: the speaker believes the statement is true but acknowledges that some information may be missing.

rules.zh: 短語後不要直接加入 that；通常先加逗號，再接完整句子。
rules.en: Do not add that directly after the phrase. Normally use a comma and then a complete clause.

rules.zh: knowledge 是不可數名詞，不可使用 knowledges。
rules.en: Knowledge is uncountable and must not be pluralised as knowledges.

rules.zh: 固定詞序是 to the best of my knowledge；不要改成 to my best knowledge 或 according to my best knowledge。
rules.en: Keep the natural fixed order to the best of my knowledge; do not use to my best knowledge or according to my best knowledge.

rules.zh: 它已表示說話者按現有資料作判斷，通常不需要再重複加入 I think。
rules.en: The phrase already shows that the statement is the speaker’s judgement based on current information, so repeating I think is normally unnecessary.

rules.zh: As far as I know 是較日常的近義表達；to the best of my knowledge 通常較審慎和正式，常見於電郵、報告和專業溝通。
rules.en: As far as I know is a more everyday synonym. To the best of my knowledge is normally more cautious and formal and is common in emails, reports and professional communication.

rules.zh: 這個短語不能掩飾純粹猜測；說話者仍應有合理資料支持陳述。
rules.en: The phrase must not disguise an unsupported guess; the speaker should still have reasonable information supporting the statement.

benefits.zh: 當相信資料正確但不能保證掌握所有細節時，它避免把不完全確定的資料說得過分肯定。
benefits.en: It prevents partially certain information from being presented too confidently when the speaker cannot guarantee every detail.

benefits.zh: 它清楚說明資料範圍，使讀者能分辨已確認內容與根據目前所知提出的內容，保持誠實可信。
benefits.en: It maintains honesty and credibility by making the limits of the speaker’s information clear.

benefits.zh: 它適合正式電郵、會議、報告、投訴回覆、調查結果和工作進度更新等專業溝通。
benefits.en: It is suitable for professional communication in emails, meetings, reports, complaint responses, investigation findings and progress updates.

benefits.zh: 它以有組織和專業的方式承認資料限制，令語氣審慎而不顯得猶豫不決。
benefits.en: It creates a cautious but organised tone without sounding indecisive.

benefits.zh: 短語可放在句首、句中或句尾，增加句式變化。
benefits.en: It can appear at the beginning, middle or end, increasing sentence variety.

benefits.zh: 它提醒讀者這是說話者目前掌握的資料，而不是宣稱絕對真相，有助區分已知事實和個人知識範圍。
benefits.en: It helps distinguish an absolute fact from information within the speaker’s present knowledge.
